statement.p: Let A = \left[\begin{array}{ccc} 1 \amp -1 \amp -7\cr -3 \amp -9 \amp 4 \end{array}\right]. Define the linear transformation T: {\mathbb R}^3 \rightarrow {\mathbb R}^2 by T(\vec{x}) = A\vec{x}. Find the images of \vec{u} = \left[\begin{array}{c} -1\cr -4\cr 5 \end{array}\right] and \vec{v} =\left[\begin{array}{c} a\cr b\cr c\cr \end{array}\right] under T.
